messages.content: [User Role: DELIVERY]
Hi, I just signed up as a delivery partner on Auxin. How do I start accepting delivery requests?

Welcome to Auxin! Once your account status is approved by the admin team, open the Delivery Portal app and toggle the availability switch at the top right to 'Available'. Your GPS location will start updating, and you will begin receiving nearby farm pickup requests.
[User Role: DELIVERY]
What documents and details are required for courier verification?

To complete your delivery partner profile, please provide:
1. Driving License Number
2. Vehicle Type (e.g. Motorcycle, Scooter, Electric Bike) and Registration Number
3. Contact Mobile Phone Number
4. Bank details (Account Number, IFSC, UPI ID) for automated weekly payout releases.
Are my bank payouts secure?
Yes! All bank details are encrypted using Fernet symmetric encryption. Weekly delivery earnings are automatically calculated and disbursed to your registered bank account every Friday.
[User Role: DELIVERY]
How am I notified when a new order is assigned to me?

When a nearby farmer accepts an order, Auxin's automated routing algorithm checks active delivery partners in the geofence. You will receive an instant audio and screen alert showing the farm pickup location, customer delivery area, distance, and payout amount. Tap 'Accept Delivery' within 45 seconds to secure the assignment.
[User Role: DELIVERY]
I accepted order #1084. What do I do when I arrive at the farm?

Milo — The AI Assistant for Auxin. Upon arriving at the farm:
1. Verify the order number (#1084) and item list with the farmer.
2. Ensure fresh produce packages are sealed and intact.
3. Tap 'Confirm Pickup' on your app to update the order status to 'Out for Delivery'.
What if the farmer isn't at the pickup location when I arrive?
Tap 'Contact Farmer' on your delivery order screen to call the farmer. If they do not answer within 5 minutes, tap 'Report Pickup Delay' in the app to notify support and trigger a re-routing check.
[User Role: DELIVERY]
I am standing at the customer's apartment gate, but the app says 'Geofence Mismatch Error'.

Auxin requires delivery partners to be within 500 meters of the customer's saved location coordinates to enter the handoff OTP. Check that your phone's GPS accuracy is set to High and refresh your location.
I refreshed GPS and walked closer to the building entrance. It works now!
Great! You can now ask the customer for their 6-digit OTP and submit it in the input box to complete the delivery.
[User Role: DELIVERY]
How do I complete a delivery and trigger escrow payment release?

When handing over the fresh produce to the customer, ask them for their 6-digit delivery OTP. Enter the code in your app and tap 'Verify OTP'. Once validated, the order status changes to 'Completed', confirming successful delivery and automatically releasing the escrow payment to the farmer.
[User Role: DELIVERY]
The customer gave me OTP 738291, but the app says 'Invalid OTP'.
Double-check the numbers with the customer to ensure no digits were misread. Ask the customer to open their Auxin app under 'Active Orders' to verify the exact 6-digit code.
They checked the app and the code is actually 738219. It verified successfully!
Awesome! The delivery is marked complete and your earnings for this trip have been added to your wallet.
[User Role: DELIVERY]
I cannot find the customer's street name. Can I call them?
Yes! Tap the 'Call Customer' button on your active delivery order screen. Use the phone call to ask for nearby landmarks or exact gate instructions to navigate easily.
[User Role: DELIVERY]
I arrived at the delivery address, but the customer is not answering the door or phone.
Please wait at the location for 10 minutes while attempting to call the customer twice more. If there is still no response, tap 'Customer Unavailable' in the app.
What should I do with the fresh produce package if they don't respond?
Do not leave fresh produce unattended. The app will instruct you to return the package to the farm pickup origin or designated hub, and you will receive return transit compensation.
[User Role: DELIVERY]
When are my delivery earnings paid out to my bank account?

All completed delivery fees and incentives accumulate in your Auxin Delivery Wallet throughout the week. Earnings are automatically paid out every Friday via direct bank transfer to your registered account.
[User Role: DELIVERY]
My motorcycle had a flat tire while carrying an active order to the customer!
First, ensure your safety. Tap 'Report Emergency / Breakdown' on your delivery order screen immediately. This notifies support and halts your active delivery timer.
Will another delivery partner be assigned to pick up the items from me?
Yes, support will reassign a nearby available courier to pick up the package from your current location and complete the delivery to the customer.
[User Role: DELIVERY]
It is raining heavily in my area. Will late delivery penalties apply?

No! Driver safety is our top priority. Auxin automatically detects severe weather conditions in your area and extends delivery SLAs without applying delay penalties. Drive carefully and take extra caution.
[User Role: DELIVERY]
I arrived at the farm, but the farmer says they are still harvesting the carrots and need 20 minutes.

Tap 'Pickup In Progress' and select 'Waiting for Harvest'. If the delay exceeds 15 minutes, you can choose to remain for a waiting allowance bonus or request an automated reassignment so you can take other orders.
[User Role: DELIVERY]
An order I accepted disappeared from my screen while I was riding to the farm.

If an order disappears, it means the customer or farmer cancelled the order before pickup. You will receive an in-app notification confirming the cancellation along with a small dispatch compensation for your distance travelled.
[User Role: DELIVERY]
I entered the correct OTP from the customer, but my mobile signal dropped and the app timed out.
Do not worry! Auxin supports offline OTP verification caching. When your signal drops, the app locally verifies the OTP format and caches the entry.
Will it sync automatically when my network returns?
Yes! As soon as your mobile data or Wi-Fi reconnects, the cached verification will sync with the backend database, completing the order and adding your payout to your wallet.
[User Role: DELIVERY]
How do I update my vehicle registration number in the app?
Go to 'Profile & Vehicle Details' in your Delivery App, tap 'Edit Vehicle Info', update your registration number (e.g. KA-03-HA-9876), and submit. Admin updates will be verified within a few hours.
[User Role: DELIVERY]
How do I end my shift when I am finished for the day?

Before ending your shift, make sure you have completed any active deliveries. Then simply toggle your availability switch to 'Unavailable / Offline'. You will stop receiving order requests until you toggle back online.
[User Role: DELIVERY]
The customer's address on the map points to an empty plot. What should I do?

Tap 'Call Customer' to request exact directions or landmark details. If the customer entered an incorrect address, ask them to send their correct pin. Note that you must still be within the 500m geofence of their registered coordinates to verify the OTP.
[User Role: DELIVERY]
How are delivery earnings calculated per order?

Each delivery earning includes a base pickup fee, a distance-based component calculated from farm to customer location, plus any active peak hour or surge incentives. You can view the full fare breakdown on every order request card.
[User Role: DELIVERY]
What backend actions happen when I verify the customer's delivery OTP?

Milo — The AI Assistant for Auxin. Verifying the 6-digit OTP triggers three key automated actions: 1. Order status updates to 'Completed'. 2. Escrow funds are released to the farmer. 3. Your delivery fee is credited to your wallet balance!
[User Role: DELIVERY]
What should I do if a Cash on Delivery (COD) customer refuses to pay?

Do not hand over the produce if payment is refused. Explain politely that COD orders require cash payment prior to OTP handoff. If they continue to refuse, tap 'Payment Refused' in your app, retain the package, and report the issue to support.
[User Role: DELIVERY]
How do Cash on Delivery (COD) collections affect my wallet balance?
When you collect cash on a COD delivery, that cash amount is deducted from your pending wallet settlement balance. Your net weekly payout will equal your total delivery earnings minus cash collected.
[User Role: DELIVERY]
Is there a maximum speed limit recommended while carrying farm fresh produce?
Please drive safely within local speed limits. Fresh produce (especially delicate items like tomatoes, berries, and milk) should be transported smoothly to avoid bruising or leakage during transit.
[User Role: DELIVERY]
My account was temporarily paused due to a driving license expiry notice. How do I reactivate it?
Upload your renewed Driving License document under 'Profile Settings'. Once our admin team verifies your renewed license, your delivery account status will be restored to 'Approved' within 4 hours.
[User Role: DELIVERY]
How are delivery requests distributed among online couriers?

Orders are automatically distributed based on proximity to the farm pickup location, current driver availability, and optimal routing distance. Staying close to active farming hubs increases your order volume!
